node.title: KoalaBear m12 outer normal-form compiler
node.closure: dihedral invariant-field normal form plus exact critical-value integration
node.statement: Every surviving inner-degree-12 outer map is geometrically affine-equivalent to one of six explicit polynomial families. The r=2 row is a Dickson quintic with two printed quadratic divided-difference factors. Four r=4 profiles have rigid normal forms and the fifth has one parameter. This is a geometric classification only: no family deletion, challenge-field coefficient descent, owner, charge, m12, u2, cap 68, or row close is claimed.
